definitions.explanation: The quality or state of being quiet and still. Derived from the adjective {静|しず}か by adding the suffix -さ. Often used to describe peaceful atmospheres in nature, at night, or in contemplative settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{静|しず}けさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: Be enveloped in the stillness of the forest.
In the quietness of the night, only the sound of insects could be heard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧しか⟦{聞|き}こえない→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧{静|しず}けさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っていた→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: A quietness in which only the sound of pens could be heard hung over the classroom during the exam.

notes:
FORMS:
{静|しず}けさ is formed from the na-adjective ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧ + the nominalizing suffix さ. This is a productive pattern: {暖|あたた}か → ⟦{暖|あたた}かさ→暖かさ：21688_atatakasa⟧, ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧ → ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧さ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {静|しず}けさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to be enveloped in stillness)
- {静|しず}けさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧ (silence hangs in the air)
- {静|しず}けさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧ (to break the silence)
- {静|しず}けさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy the quiet)
- ⟦{不気味|ぶきみ}→不気味：16040_bukimi⟧な{静|しず}けさ (an eerie silence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {静|しず}けさ: quietness, stillness (atmospheric quality)
- ⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧: silence (deliberate absence of speech)
- ⟦{静寂|せいじゃく}→静寂：09055_seijaku⟧: deep silence (more literary/formal)
